_comment: Apple Silicon MLX set. These *-mlx tags use Ollama's MLX backend (Ollama 0.31+) and run only on Apple Silicon Macs; on Apple hardware MLX is materially faster than the GGUF/Metal path (e.g. Gemma 4 gains multi-token prediction). Run with: python3 scripts/ollama_bench.py --config ollama-bench-mac-mlx.json
